title: SILL PLATE & TRIM MOLDING
summary: Door sill plate (the scuff plate on top of the door sill) and the outside rocker/sill trim molding (the rocker molding below the door), LH/RH. The sill plate screws down onto the top of the sill; the rocker molding screws sideways into clip nuts on the body sill, with one screw from below at its front end into a nut at the front fender.

parts.name: MOLDING
parts.name_expanded: Molding – rocker panel / sill trim molding (LH/RH)

parts.name: PLATE
parts.name_expanded: Plate – door sill plate (sill scuff plate)

materials.where: upper right, on the body at the rear end of the door opening (lock pillar / sill area) above the molding's rear end

fastening.note: Screws [8] go down through the sill plate [7] into the holes along the top of the sill (several places).
Screws [2] go in from the outside through the molding [1] into clip nuts [6] on the body: one at the rear end, two at the front end and front-middle.
Screw [3] goes in from the outside through the molding [1] near its middle/rear.
Screw [4] goes up from below through the front end of the molding [1] into nut [5] at the front of the door opening.
